'''Eric Guerrero''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Los Angeles tournament]] in May 2001 with Bothawui Op's deck, according to Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2391">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-28-alderaan-may-25th-01d2391/ alderaan-may-25th-01], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 28 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-28-alderaan-may-25th-01d2391/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
